summary.text: Brenton Baldwin is the Labor candidate for Bendigo West at the 2026 Victorian election, in the seat held by retiring Labor MP Maree Edwards. Born and raised in Bendigo, he went to local public schools and graduated from La Trobe University's Bendigo campus. His current work is in not-for-profit health, and he was earlier a staffer for the former Labor upper house MP Jenny Mikakos.

priorities.text: Health care close to home in regional Victoria, drawing on his work in the health sector
Fairness, dignity at work and strong public services, the values his party page says he grew up with

summary.text: David Hutchings is the Nationals candidate for Bendigo West at the 2026 Victorian election. A chartered accountant who came to Australia from the United Kingdom in the early 1990s, he has worked as an auditor in regional Victoria and says he spent most of almost three decades as a partner in a Bendigo firm. He is also a Country Fire Authority volunteer with the Lockwood and Bendigo brigades.

prior_roles.note: His party page puts most of nearly 30 years as a chartered accountant as a partner in a local firm; it names neither the firm nor the years.
The ABC says almost 15 years of CFA volunteering; his party page says close to 30 years.

priorities.text: Bendigo West deserves someone who knows it from the inside
Tighter state budgeting, less waste and paying down debt
Tackling crime and keeping local services from being cut back
A fair share of state funding for the region

sources.title: Bendigo West: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
David Hutchings, Candidate for Bendigo West, The Nationals Victoria

summary.text: Debra Tranter is the Animal Justice Party candidate for Bendigo West at the 2026 Victorian state election. She has campaigned on animal welfare since the 1990s and in 2010 started Oscar's Law, a campaign against puppy farming that the party credits with the Victorian laws banning puppy farms in 2017. Her party page says she is a registered nurse with a background in aged care management and is now a volunteer manager of the Castlemaine cemetery.

sources.title: Debra Tranter for Bendigo West, Animal Justice Party Victoria
Bendigo West, 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Ellen Morgan is the One Nation candidate for Bendigo West at the 2026 Victorian election. The ABC's guide says she has worked in youth justice and the community services sector, and that she credits that work with shaping her advocacy around Bendigo. Her One Nation candidate page refused automated requests, and no other source we could read had published more about her as at early November 2026.

occupation.text: Community services and youth justice worker

sources.title: Bendigo West: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Liza Shaw is the Greens candidate for Bendigo West at the 2026 Victorian election. A community health worker, she says she has lived and worked in Bendigo West and the Mount Alexander area for more than ten years, and with her family runs a small fruit farm at Muckleford. She describes herself as a climate advocate.

prior_roles.role: Runs a small family fruit farm, Muckleford

priorities.text: protect our environment, expand affordable housing, tackle the cost-of-living crisis
fight for First Nations justice and LGBTQIA+ equality
Decisions made with the community rather than imposed from the top down

sources.title: Bendigo West: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Tayne Shalevski is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Bendigo West at the 2026 Victorian election. He works as a building company foreman, has done construction work around regional Victoria, and says he grew up in the electorate and lives there now. In March 2026 he contested a Lockwood Ward by-election for the City of Greater Bendigo, receiving 5.1 per cent of first preferences.

previous_candidacies.election: March 2026 City of Greater Bendigo Lockwood Ward by-election

Holding developers, property investors, the big banks and supermarket chains to account for rising inequality
Opposing racism and campaigning in solidarity with Palestinians
Being a radical voice for working people in regional Victoria
